name: create specter
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently.
The target's spirit rises as a specter in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s control. the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have no more than seven specters under its control at one time.
